metadata.description: UI design skills and plugins, built from researched patterns with concrete tokens.

plugins.name: dashboard-ui
plugins.description: Dashboard UI design: 71 researched patterns (hierarchy, data display, charts, colour, components, motion, progressive UI) plus a review rubric and starter tokens.

plugins.name: marketing-ui
plugins.description: Landing pages, marketing sites and product pages: 19 researched patterns (narrative, hero, proof, features and bento, pricing, FAQ, footer, type and art direction, generated-default tells, motion, LCP, fonts, SEO) plus a review rubric and a token layer.

plugins.name: mobile-ui
plugins.description: Mobile web, responsive apps and PWAs: 19 researched patterns (thumb reach, 44pt/48dp/24px targets, safe areas, dvh/svh and the keyboard, bottom nav, sheets and detents, gestures, mobile forms, lists and tables, Dynamic Type, dark mode, haptics, PWA install and offline, low-end performance, foldables) with Apple HIG and Material 3 conventions, plus a review rubric and mobile tokens.

plugins.name: motion-ui
plugins.description: Product-UI motion and gesture: 19 researched patterns (purpose and frequency, durations and easing, springs mapped across CSS, Motion, React Spring, SwiftUI and Material 3, drag, momentum, sheets, enter/exit, View Transitions, scroll-driven animation, performance, reduced motion) plus a frame-based review rubric and motion tokens.

plugins.name: forms-ui
plugins.description: Web form design: 19 researched patterns (layout, labels, input types and autofill, choice controls, money/date/phone/file inputs, validation and errors, submission, multi-step flows, passkeys) plus an anti-pattern catalogue, a review rubric and starter form styles.

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Set up and keep a coherent design system in your project: 11 researched patterns (token architecture and versioning, DTCG, theming and multi-brand, dark mode, type, spacing and radius scales, Tailwind v4/shadcn/CSS Modules/MUI mappings, evidence-based domain profiles, drift detection), a verified OKLCH theme generator (WCAG 2 + APCA, light/dark/high contrast) and a DESIGN.md decision record.

plugins.name: ai-ui
plugins.description: UI for AI features: 20 researched patterns (AI identity and expectations, uncertainty without crying wolf, latency budgets, privacy and consent, accessible generated content, chat layout, streaming and stop, thinking and agent steps, markdown and code, citations, edit/regenerate/branching, IME-safe prompt input, suggestions, errors/refusals/rate limits, feedback, ghost text and diffs, agent approval and audit, WebMCP) plus an anti-pattern catalogue, a review rubric and AI-UI tokens.
